Title: Participant details page shows the fields and buttons
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads My account and a second heading reads Edit Participant Details.

Step Action: Look at the contact and address fields.
Step Expected: The fields Contact Name, Organisation Name, Address 1, Address 2, Address 3, Address 4 and Address 5 are visible.

Step Action: Look at the Country, Telephone and email fields.
Step Expected: The fields Country, Telephone, Email (Primary) and Email (Secondary) are visible.

Step Action: Open the Country list without choosing a value.
Step Expected: The list is populated and contains Afghanistan.

Step Action: Look at the buttons below the form without selecting them.
Step Expected: The buttons UPDATE DETAILS and CANCEL are visible.

Title: Submitting participant details without a Country is blocked
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The h1 reads My account and the form is editable.

Step Action: Clear the Country field so that no country is selected.
Step Expected: The Country field shows no selected country.

Step Action: Select UPDATE DETAILS.
Step Expected: The page stays on Edit Participant Details.

Step Action: Read the message shown for Country.
Step Expected: The message The Country for this participant must be specified is shown.

Step Action: Look for the submitted message.
Step Expected: The message Updated details submitted is not shown.

Step Action: Check the form fields and the UPDATE DETAILS button.
Step Expected: The fields are still editable and the form is not locked.

Step Action: Cleanup: select CANCEL.
Step Expected: The page leaves the form and no data has been changed.

Title: Cancel on participant details returns to Home without saving
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The h1 reads My account.

Step Action: Note the current value of Contact Name as <original contact name>.
Step Expected: The original value is recorded.

Step Action: Replace the Contact Name value with Cancelled Contact <run id>.
Step Expected: The Contact Name field shows Cancelled Contact <run id>.

Step Action: Select CANCEL.
Step Expected: The browser opens /Home.aspx and the h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx again.
Step Expected: The h1 reads My account and Contact Name shows <original contact name>, not Cancelled Contact <run id>.

Step Action: Cleanup: select CANCEL.
Step Expected: The browser returns to /Home.aspx and no data has been changed.

Title: A valid participant update is submitted and the confirmation shows
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/EditParticipantDetails.aspx as a signed-in external user whose form is not locked.
Step Expected: The h1 reads My account and the form is editable.

Step Action: Enter Jane Smith in Contact Name and test@example.com in Email (Primary).
Step Expected: The two fields show the entered values.

Step Action: Enter <synthetic telephone number> in Telephone.
Step Expected: The Telephone field shows the entered value.

Step Action: Choose Afghanistan in Country and check that every required field is filled.
Step Expected: Country shows Afghanistan and no validation message is shown.

Step Action: Select UPDATE DETAILS.
Step Expected: The message Updated details submitted is shown.

Step Action: Read the text that follows the message.
Step Expected: The text reads Changes have already been submitted. Please wait for those changes to be approved or rejected before submitting further changes.

Step Action: Cleanup: ask the environment owner to reset the database to remove the pending update.
Step Expected: The form on /EditParticipantDetails.aspx is editable again after the reset.
